svg.aria-label: Two distinct model deviations. Left: unabsorbed stray light produces a high-absorbance ceiling; s is its intensity relative to the intended blank light. Right: a constructed absorption band and an inverse-fourth-power wavelength-dependent scattering loss illustrate full-spectrum diagnostics using an additive apparent-attenuation approximation.
